access_links.label: ArcGIS Urban overview (trial and purchase options)

description: ArcGIS Urban is Esri's web application for collaborative, data-driven urban planning, in which zoning, land-use and development scenarios are evaluated with 3D visualisations and urban analytics in the context of a city's digital twin. Its capabilities are 3D scenario modelling, data-driven analysis with ready-to-use space uses, building types and metrics that show the impact of policy and development changes in real time, project e-submission that brings BIM, external 3D content and permitting data into the review of the development pipeline, and collaborative planning with online feedback. It integrates with other products through its API, including extended reality for exploring plans, and Esri says no 3D data is required to start. Esri frames it around housing shortages, climate resilience and economic uncertainty, for planners, stakeholders and the public. Coverage: generic; any city or town set up by the user. Access: free trial and purchase through Esri. Licence: commercial. Caveats: proprietary and tied to the ArcGIS system; metrics depend on the space uses and building types configured. Simulation uses: zoning capacity and development scenarios, housing capacity planning and public space design in a city digital twin. Related records: ArcGIS CityEngine, ArcGIS Indoors and the Tygron Platform.
